prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: My bag is more heavy than yours.
My bag is heavier than yours.
My bag is more heavier than yours.
answer: My bag is heavier than yours.

heavy 是短形容詞，比較級要把 y 改成 i 再加 -er，變成 heavier，不用 more。
more 和 -er 不能同時使用，這樣就變成雙重比較級。

why: 短的形容詞用 -er 表示比較級，heavy 要變成 heavier。
tip: 短字加 -er，長字前面加 more，兩者不重複。
say: My bag is heavier than yours.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: This movie is _____ than the one we saw last week.

wrong.excitinger: exciting 是長形容詞，比較級不能加 -er，要用 more exciting。
wrong.most exciting: most 是最高級，但句中有 than，表示兩者比較，要用比較級。
wrong.exciting: 原級不能和 than 一起比較，需要變成比較級 more exciting。

why: 兩個東西比較用比較級，長形容詞前加 more。
tip: 有 than 就用比較級。
say: This movie is more exciting than the one we saw last week.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: Of all the students in my class, Ellie is the _____ runner.

wrong.fast: fast 是原級，要表示『全班最快』需要用最高級。
wrong.faster: faster 是比較級，用來比較兩個人；這裡是全班同學中最快，要用最高級。
wrong.most fast: fast 是短形容詞，最高級是 fastest，不是 most fast。

why: Of all ... 表示在全體中比較，短形容詞最高級用 the + -est。
tip: 最高級前面通常要加 the。
say: Ellie is the fastest runner in my class.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: I enjoy to swim in the summer.
I enjoy swimming in the summer.
I enjoy swim in the summer.
answer: I enjoy swimming in the summer.

enjoy 後面要接動名詞 V-ing，不能接 to 不定詞。
enjoy 後面不能直接接原形動詞，要改成 swimming。

why: enjoy 是要接動名詞（V-ing）的動詞。
say: I enjoy swimming in the summer.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: My sister wants _____ a doctor when she grows up.

wrong.being: want 後面要接不定詞 to V，不能直接接 V-ing。
wrong.be: want 和原形動詞之間要有 to，不能直接接 be。
wrong.been: been 是完成式用的過去分詞，不能直接放在 want 後面。

why: want 後面接 to + 原形動詞。
say: My sister wants to be a doctor when she grows up.

prompt: 你想有禮貌地請對方「關掉音樂」，哪一句最適合？
options: Would you mind turning off the music?
Would you mind turn off the music?
Would you mind to turn off the music?
answer: Would you mind turning off the music?

wrong.Would you mind turn off the music?: mind 後面要接動名詞，turn 要改成 turning。
wrong.Would you mind to turn off the music?: mind 後面不接 to 不定詞，要接 V-ing。

why: Would you mind + V-ing 是有禮貌的請求用法。
tip: Would you mind 後面接 V-ing。
say: Would you mind turning off the music?

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: _____ books is a good way to learn new words.

wrong.Read: 句子的主詞位置不能放原形動詞，要變成動名詞。
wrong.To reading: to 後面接原形，to reading 搭配錯誤。
wrong.Reads: reads 是第三人稱單數動詞，不能直接當主詞。

why: 動名詞（V-ing）可以當句子的主詞，表示『做某事』這件事。
tip: 要把動作當主詞，就用 V-ing。
say: Reading books is a good way to learn new words.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: He is the tallest than all his friends.
He is the tallest of all his friends.
He is taller of all his friends.
answer: He is the tallest of all his friends.

最高級不搭配 than，要用 of 或 in 表示範圍。
of all 表示在全體中比，要用最高級 the tallest，不是比較級。

why: 最高級 the tallest 後面用 of 或 in 表示範圍。
tip: 最高級用 of／in，比較級用 than。
say: He is the tallest of all his friends.

prompt: 『I stopped to drink water.』的意思是？

wrong.我停止喝水: 停止做某事要說 stop drinking，不是 stop to drink。
wrong.我喝水喝到停: stop to drink 的 to 是『為了』的意思，後面接停下來要做的事，不是『喝到停』這種說法。
wrong.我停下來看別人喝水: drink water 的主詞是 I，是我自己要喝水，不是看別人喝。

why: stop to V 是『停下來去做另一件事』，stop V-ing 才是『不再做』。
tip: stop to V 停下來去做；stop V-ing 停止。

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: Tom is _____ than his brother, so he can reach the top shelf.

wrong.tall: 原級不能和 than 一起用。
wrong.tallest: 最高級是三者以上比較，這句有 than，要用比較級。
wrong.more tall: tall 是短形容詞，比較級要用 taller。

why: 兩人比較用比較級，tall 變 taller。
say: Tom is taller than his brother.

prompt: 朋友問你想不想去看電影，你想說「我喜歡看電影，但今天想待在家」。哪一句最自然？
options: I like watching movies, but I'd like to stay home today.
I like watch movies, but I'd like staying home today.
I like to watching movies, but I'd like stay home today.
answer: I like watching movies, but I'd like to stay home today.

wrong.I like watch movies, but I'd like stayin: like 後面要接 V-ing 或 to V，不能直接接 watch；而 would like 後面要接 to V。
wrong.I like to watching movies, but I'd like: to 和 -ing 不能混用，would like 後面也要接 to stay。

why: like 可接 V-ing 表示一般喜好；would like 後面要接 to V。
tip: like 接 V-ing；would like 接 to V。
say: I like watching movies, but I'd like to stay home today.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: Mia was not good at _____ the piano, so she practiced every day.

wrong.play: 介系詞 at 後面不能直接接原形動詞。
wrong.to play: 介系詞後面要接名詞或 V-ing，不接 to V。
wrong.played: 介系詞後面不能接過去式。

why: 介系詞後面的動詞要改成動名詞（V-ing）。
tip: 介系詞後面的動詞用 V-ing。
say: Mia was not good at playing the piano.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: This soup is more delicious as that one.
This soup is more delicious than that one.
This soup is delicious than that one.
answer: This soup is more delicious than that one.

比較級要搭配 than，不是 as。
delicious 是長形容詞，要變成 more delicious 才能和 than 一起用。

why: 比較級的固定結構是 more + 形容詞 + than。
tip: 比較級後面用 than，別用 as。
say: This soup is more delicious than that one.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: The weather is getting _____ and colder as winter comes.

wrong.cold: and 前後要用相同形式，前面已經是 colder，後面也要用 colder。
wrong.coldest: 『越來越』用比較級 and 比較級，不是最高級。
wrong.more cold: cold 是短形容詞，比較級是 colder。

why: 比較級 + and + 比較級表示『越來越……』。
tip: 越來越：比較級 and 比較級。
say: The weather is getting colder and colder.

prompt: 老師說：「請記得明天帶課本。」你想表示會記得去做這件事，哪一句最合適？
options: I will remember to bring my textbook.
I will remember bringing my textbook.
I will remember bring my textbook.
answer: I will remember to bring my textbook.

remember V-ing 是『記得做過某事』，說的是過去，不是記得去做。
remember 後面不能直接接原形動詞，要用 to bring。

why: remember to V 是『記得要去做』，用於還沒做的事。
tip: remember to V 是記得去做；V-ing 是記得做過。
say: I will remember to bring my textbook.
